definitions.full: H4549. masas [ מָסַס ] verb dissolve, melt , intransitive ( מְסַס ᵑ7 ; compare מסה , and II. מאס ); — Qal. Infinitive construct נֹסֵס מְסֹס Isa 10:18 ; like the melting (wasting away) of a נֹסֵס (q. v.) Niph`al Perfect וְנָמֵס consecutive Ezek 21:12 ; וְנָמָ֑ס Exod 16:21 ; Psa 112:10 ; נָמַ֫סּוּ 97:5 2 t; Imperfect יִמַּס Deut 20:8 +; וַיִּמַּסּוּ Judg 15:14 ; Infinitive absolute הִמֵּס 2Sam 17:10 ; construct id. Psa 68:3 ; Participle נָמֵס 22:15 2 t.; — 1 melt (intransitive) of manna Exod 16:21 ; wax Psa 68:3 (simile of wicked); manacles Judg 15:14 (= vanished, dropped off ); wicked Psa 112:10 ( melt away ); especially of hills and mountains Micah 1:4 ; Psa 97:5 ; Isa 34:3 . 2 most often figurative of heart = faint, grow fearful , Nahum 2:11 ; 2Sam 17:10 (twice in verse) (compare Dr), Deut 20:8 ; Josh 2:11 ; 5:1 ; 7:5 ; Isa 13:7 ; 19:1 ; Ezek 21:12 ; Psa 22:15 . 3 Participle = wasted, consumptive (?), 1Sam 15:9 (|| נְמִבְזָה , read נִבְזָה see בזה Niph`al ) < read נִמְאֶסֶת worthless , literally rejected (see מאס Niph`al ) Hiph`il Perfect 3plural אֶתלְֿבָבֵנוּ הֵמַסּוּ Deut 1:28 cause to melt ( = intimidate).
